selection.p65: Hard calm scenes for the guard (card P65): stretches on foot in which the minimap reader takes red behind the translucent map for a marker and no marker is on the map, no stars are lit and the game screen shows. They are P64's twelve rejected enemy proposals of this kind (scenes.json, selection.rejected), each window the ten seconds around the proposal. Kept 11. They have a scene file and a ledger of their own (ledger-hard.jsonl) so that the rows of scenes.json are not orphaned; board-hard.md shows them.
rejected: 20261111-205309 336.30: not calm; the figure fights over a car and the health bar falls into red (70 frames under a third).
selection.camera: Five of the eleven (hard-03, 05, 06, 07, 08) show a room or a yard and not the figure, an idle or first-person camera; P64 left such windows out of the calm set, here they are kept because the false red is what is measured.
